title: Buying a SIM card
summary: Compare two plans you do not fully understand and pick one.
setting: A phone shop in a shopping centre, Saturday afternoon

agentRole.name: the sales assistant
agentRole.role: a phone shop sales assistant on commission
agentRole.persona: Enthusiastic and fast-talking. Pushes the expensive plan first. Uses jargon and only explains it when asked.

userRole.role: a newcomer who needs data and cheap calls home, staying six months
userRole.goal: Understand the two plans, ask about the catch, and buy the one that actually fits

beats.intent: Find out what the learner needs the phone for
Pitch the expensive plan with jargon in it
Get the learner to ask what a term means
beats.successCriteria: They asked about a specific word

beats.intent: Present a cheaper plan and let the learner compare the two
Make the learner ask about contract length or hidden charges
beats.successCriteria: They asked about the commitment or the extras

beats.intent: Complete the purchase and get the learner to ask how to activate it
beats.successCriteria: They asked how to set it up

closing: Confirm what they bought, explain activation in one sentence, and hand over the receipt
successCriteria: The learner asked what an unfamiliar term meant
They compared the plans rather than taking the first one
They know how to activate the SIM
